title: chore(ci): refresh the Test UI per-file timings dataset
body:

shard split is balanced on. Opened automatically by
`.github/workflows/ui-test-timings-refresh.yml`. Every byte came out of
`ui/scripts/test-file-timings.mjs merge`; nothing here was hand-edited, and no bound,
timeout or matrix entry was touched.
